title: Bread of Heaven, on Thee We Feed
description: Bread of Heaven, on Thee We Feed in Tonic Solfa to ARFON: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the two verses, and a piano.
about: Josiah Conder’s words were published in his collection The Star in the East in 1824; he wrote them in the first person (“on Thee I feed”), and hymn books later changed them to “we”. The tune ARFON is a Welsh folk melody, printed in Edward Jones’s Relicks of the Welsh Bards in 1784.

lines: Bread of heaven, on Thee we feed,
For Thy flesh is meat indeed:
Ever may our souls be fed
With this true and living Bread;
Day by day with strength supplied,
Through the life of Him who died.
Vine of heaven, Thy blood supplies
Lord, Thy wounds our healing give,
To Thy cross we look and live:
